name: nextastore-ai-assistant
description: Self-hosted AI assistant (Nexi) for NextaStore. Everything runs on this machine: a light local chat model via Ollama, in-memory keyword search over the knowledge files (no embedding model, no reindex), and optional on-server Ganda Gemma 1B for Luganda replies.

scripts.test:wip93: node scripts/wip93-test.js && node scripts/wip93-widget-test.js && node scripts/wip93-lg-review-test.js
scripts.eval:retrieval: node scripts/retrieval-eval.js --min-top1 0.9 --min-top3 0.97 && node scripts/retrieval-eval.js --gold scripts/golden/retrieval-heldout.json --min-top1 0.85 --min-top3 0.95 && node scripts/retrieval-eval.js --gold scripts/golden/retrieval-blind-40.json --min-top1 0.9 --min-top3 0.95 && node scripts/retrieval-eval.js --gold scripts/golden/blind-4.json --min-top1 0.7 --min-top5 0.9 && node scripts/oos-eval.js --min 0.9
scripts.test:wip97: node scripts/alias-lint.js && npm run eval:retrieval && node scripts/wip97-test.js && node scripts/model-personalities-test.js && node scripts/wip97-answer-changes.js
